the observed anomalies in the chloroplast ultrastructure are the results of the overproduction of endogenous cytokinns in transgenic Pssu- ipt plants.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Pssu CKs, in excess, affect the ultrastructural organization of the chloroplasts and, as a result, the photosynthetic performance of the plant.
the anomalous chloroplast structures in Pssu- ipt tobacco are formed due to the enhanced endogenous cytokinines and that they do not impair photosynthesis.
Pssu ipt tobacco plants are a good model system for studying the effect of cytokinins on chloroplast structure and function.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CKs, as well as other plant growth regulators, can affect the ultrastructure of plant organelles.
CKs may affect not only the photosynthetic activity of the chloroplasts, but may also influence their structure.
the anomalous structures in Pssu- ipt chloroplasts are not formed randomly.
